description: Re-check one of your own MCP servers and reload its tool list (e.g. after the server added tools). Optionally a new token or url. Required: name. scope private (default) or tenant.

name.description: Name of your registered MCP server to re-check

scope.description: Whether the server is your private one (default) or the tenant's

token.description: New access token for the server, if it changed

url.description: New server URL, if it changed

name: refresh_custom_mcp_server
